explanation.headline: Quetiapine fumarate is not on FDA's shortage list; both Corvale sites use product from Aurobindo Pharma Limited, which had an OAI inspection in 2010 and a VAI inspection in 2023-07-21

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include quetiapine fumarate as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 45 tablets of the 100 mg presentation, providing 5.7 days of supply at 7.8 tablets per day.
Corvale General holds 204 tablets of the same 100 mg presentation, providing 24.4 days of supply at 8.4 tablets per day.
Both sites' inventory is labeled by Aurobindo Pharma Limited (NDC 65862049101).
The label identifies Aurobindo Pharma Limited as the registered plant (FEI 3004021229) with a most recent VAI inspection on 2023-07-21.
FDA records also show an OAI classification for this plant from an inspection ending 2010-09-24.
The top-ranked action is to transfer 65 tablets of 100 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would leave Corvale General with 17 days on hand and bring Corvale East to 14 days.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.
